description: Conversation bundle v1: what conv.export streams and conv.import.begin accepts. A 12-byte header (magic SPCB, version 1, three zero bytes, manifest length as u32 big-endian), a UTF-8 JSON manifest of allowlisted logical paths with sizes and SHA-256, then each entry's bytes concatenated in manifest order, and nothing after them. No modes, symlinks, directories or absolute paths: the target computes every destination from conv.import.begin's own agent and conversation_id, which it validates first ('requests'), and refuses a manifest that names any other ('manifests'; every manifest case is carried by the begin in 'request'). proto/README.md, 'Conversation bundle v1', is the specification; daemon D2 writes and reads it (daemon/src/host_bundle.rs).
